definition_zh: v. 取代；使离开原位；迫使…离开家园
definition_en: to take the place of something, or to force it out of its usual position or home
core_image: 新机器挤进旧机器占的位置；地震把石块挪离原来的标记；一家人拎着包站在别人家门口
scene: 战争把两百万人从家里赶了出来。The war displaced two million people.
sceneCN: 第 3 个义项：战争让两百万人被迫离开家园。

pos.zh: 取代；使离开原位；迫使离开家园

senses.title: Take the place of
senses.definition: to take the position or job that something else had
senses.definitionCN: （动词）占据原本属于别的东西的位置或工作
senses.example: Streaming has displaced the DVD.
senses.exampleCN: 流媒体取代了 DVD。
senses.why: A new machine pushed into the spot an old one occupied.
senses.whyCN: 一台新机器挤进旧机器原先占的位置。

senses.title: Move out of position
senses.definition: to move something out of its usual or correct place
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把某物从通常或正确的位置上挪开
senses.example: The quake displaced the rocks by two metres.
senses.exampleCN: 地震把那些岩石挪开了两米。
senses.why: A stone shifted off the mark it had sat on.
senses.whyCN: 一块石头从它一直待着的标记上被挪开。

senses.title: Force from home
senses.definition: to force people to leave their home or country
senses.definitionCN: （动词）迫使人们离开家园或国土
senses.example: The war displaced two million people.
senses.exampleCN: 战争使两百万人流离失所。
senses.why: A family standing outside a locked door with bags.
senses.whyCN: 一家人拎着包站在一扇锁着的门外。

intro.en: Displace is dis- plus place, and place travels back through Old French and Latin platea to Greek plateia, a broad way, from platys, broad or flat.
intro.cn: displace 由 dis- 加 place 构成，而 place 一路经古法语、拉丁语 platea 追溯到希腊语 plateia「宽阔的路」，来自 platys「宽、平」。

items.en: Greek platys means broad or flat.
items.cn: 希腊语 platys 意为宽的、平的。

items.en: Greek plateia hodos means a broad way.
items.cn: 希腊语 plateia hodos 意为宽阔的道路。

items.en: Latin platea means a courtyard or broad street.
items.cn: 拉丁语 platea 意为庭院或宽阔街道。

items.en: Old French place means an open space in a town.
items.cn: 古法语 place 意为城中的空地。

items.en: English place keeps the sense of a position.
items.cn: 英语 place 保留位置这一意思。

items.en: Displace appears for putting something out of its place.
items.cn: displace 出现，表示把某物从原位挪走。

note.en: Displace is pushing something off its spot; its look-alikes share the place root, and its neighbours name other ways of taking a spot or leaving it.
note.cn: displace 是把东西从它的位置上推开；形近词共用 place 这个词根，近义词则是别的占位或离位方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: displace ＝ dis-（离开、去掉）＋ place（位置，源自希腊语 platys「宽平」→ plateia「宽路」→ 拉丁语 platea「广场」→ 古法语 place）＝把某人某物从原来的位置上挪走，「取代、使流离失所」；物理里的 displacement 就是排开的水量或位移。

root: 希腊语 platys（宽平）→ plateia（宽路）→ 拉丁语 platea（广场）→ 古法语 place → 英语 displace

sensesIntro.en: A spot changed hands: a new machine in an old place, a stone off its mark and a family outside a locked door.
sensesIntro.cn: 位置换了主人：旧位置上的新机器、离开标记的石头与锁门外的一家人。

branches.en: Both leave the original spot empty.

branches.cn: 两者都是被迫离开某个地方。

intro.en: Displace is dis- plus place; the same broad-flat root builds plate, platform and plateau, while dis- builds displacement and disarm.
intro.cn: displace 由 dis- 加 place 构成；同一个「宽平」词根也造出 plate、platform 与 plateau，而 dis- 造出 displacement 与 disarm。

latinIntro.en: Latin platea means a broad street, Greek plateia a broad way and platys broad or flat.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 platea 意为宽阔街道，希腊语 plateia 意为宽路，platys 意为宽平。

definition_zh: 展示；显示；显示屏
definition_en: to put something where people can see it, or to show a feeling or quality
core_image: 玻璃柜里一排东西被灯照亮，标签朝外
scene: 她脸上一点担忧也没显出来。Her face displayed no sign of worry.
sceneCN: 这里 display 指「显示」（第 2 个义项：把情绪或特质表露出来）；句意是她脸上没有显出担忧。

senses.title: To put something out to be seen
senses.definition: to arrange something so that people can look at it
senses.definitionCN: 把东西摆出来供人观看
senses.example: The shop displays new bags in the window.
senses.exampleCN: 商店把新包展示在橱窗里。
senses.why: A lamp and a clean shelf do half the selling.
senses.whyCN: 一盏灯和一层干净的架子，就完成了一半的销售。

senses.title: To show a feeling or quality
senses.definition: to let a feeling or quality be seen
senses.definitionCN: 让某种情绪或特质显现出来
senses.example: Her face displayed no worry.
senses.exampleCN: 她脸上没有显出担忧。
senses.why: The body speaks before the mouth decides to.
senses.whyCN: 身体先说话，嘴还没决定要不要说。

senses.title: A screen that shows information
senses.definition: an electronic screen that shows information
senses.definitionCN: 显示信息的电子屏幕
senses.example: The display went dark.
senses.exampleCN: 显示屏黑了。
senses.why: A shop window shrank into a pane of light.
senses.whyCN: 橱窗缩成了一块发光的玻璃。

intro.en: Display comes from Latin displicare, to unfold, from dis- and plicare, to fold, through Old French despleier.
intro.cn: display 来自拉丁语 displicare（展开），由 dis- 与 plicare（折叠）构成，经古法语 despleier 进入英语。

items.en: Plicare meant to fold something flat.
items.cn: plicare 指把东西折叠起来。

items.en: Displicare meant to unfold it again.
items.cn: displicare 指重新把它展开。

items.en: Despleier meant to spread out or unfurl.
items.cn: 古法语 despleier 指铺开、展旗。

items.en: English display meant to spread out a banner.
items.cn: 英语 display 最初指展开旗帜。

items.en: It now covers goods, feelings and lit screens.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖货物、情绪与发光的屏幕。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the play-like ending, and the meaning group names other ways of showing.
note.cn: 形近组保留近似 play 的词尾，近义组列出别的展示方式。

entries.definition: to take part in a game or a performance
a second showing of a recorded action
put out where people can see it
to show something in a public place
to let something be seen
a flat surface that shows images

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a lit glass case and end with a pane of light.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只亮起的玻璃柜开始，落到一块发光的平面。

normal.en: Dis- plus play: the folded thing is opened out.
normal.cn: dis 加 play，把折着的东西展开。

normal.en: A window display sells before any word is spoken.
normal.cn: 橱窗陈列在任何一句话之前就在卖货。

normal.en: A face can display what a mouth refuses to say.
normal.cn: 嘴不肯说的，脸可以先显示出来。

normal.en: The display on a phone is a window made of glass and light.
normal.cn: 手机的显示屏，是一扇玻璃与光做的窗。

normal.en: Goods on display are easier to want than to need.
normal.cn: 陈列着的货，容易让人想买，而不是需要。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switched on above a glass shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃架上方的灯亮了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a box so the label faces out.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把盒子转得标签朝外。

abstract.en: Picture a small screen glowing in a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象暗屋里一块小屏在发光。

examples.en: Her face displayed no sign of worry.
examples.cn: 她脸上没有显出担忧。

examples.en: The museum displays old maps in a long hall.
examples.cn: 博物馆在一条长廊里展示旧地图。

examples.en: The display on the machine showed an error.
examples.cn: 机器上的显示屏显示了错误。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 display 记成「摆开来看」：dis 表示展开，词根与折叠的拉丁词有关，把折起的东西摊开摆好，就是展示。

root: 源自拉丁语 displicare（展开），由 dis-（分开）与 plicare（折叠）构成，经古法语 despleier 进入英语。本义是把折起或卷起的东西摊开，所以有「摆出来给人看」的意思，后来指把情绪显在脸上，现代又指发光的显示屏。

sensesIntro.en: From a banner spread open in the air to a pane of light on a desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 从空中展开的旗帜，到桌上那块发光的平面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit glass case with every label facing out.
core.cn: 核心意象：亮起的玻璃柜，每张标签都朝外。

branches.en: The first sense is an object spread out for the eyes.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是摆出来给眼睛看的物件。

branches.en: The second sense is a feeling laid open the same way.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是用同样方式摊开的情绪。

branches.en: The third sense is the glass that does the showing.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是替人展示的那块玻璃。

branches.en: Both senses depend on being looked at.
branches.cn: 两个义项都要被看见才成立。

branches.en: A face and a screen both show without sound.
branches.cn: 脸和屏幕都能无声地显示。

intro.en: Display belongs to the plicare family of folding, where unfold and employ share a root.
intro.cn: display 属于 plicare（折叠）一族，展开与使用共用同一个根。

latinIntro.en: Latin plicare, to fold, gives displicare and display, and the same stem hides in employ and reply.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plicare（折叠）给出 displicare 与 display，同一词干也藏在 employ 与 reply 里。

items.example: They display the cups near the door.

definition_zh: adj. 一次性的；可丢弃的；可自由支配的
definition_en: made to be thrown away after use, or available to be used as one wishes
core_image: 喝一次就进垃圾桶的纸杯；诊所里戴一只丢一只的手套；付完账单后掌心剩下的几枚硬币
scene: 诊所抽屉里一整盒手套，用一只丢一只。The clinic uses disposable gloves.

senses.definition: made to be thrown away after a single use

senses.exampleCN: 诊所使用一次性手套。
senses.why: A paper cup dropped into a bin after one drink.
senses.whyCN: 一只喝过一次就被丢进垃圾桶的纸杯。

senses.title: Able to be got rid of

senses.example: Most of the packaging is disposable.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分包装都是可丢弃的。
senses.why: A wrapper peeled off and dropped on the ground.
senses.whyCN: 一张被剥下丢在地上的包装纸。

senses.title: Free to be spent
senses.definition: left over to be used or spent as one wishes
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）剩下可按自己意愿使用或花掉的
senses.example: Rent takes half of her disposable income.

senses.why: Coins left in a palm after the bills are paid.
senses.whyCN: 付完账单后掌心剩下的几枚硬币。

intro.en: Disposable is dispose plus -able, and dispose comes through Old French disposer from Latin disponere, to arrange, from dis- plus ponere, to put or place.
intro.cn: disposable 由 dispose 加 -able 构成，而 dispose 经古法语 disposer 来自拉丁语 disponere「安排」，由 dis- 加 ponere「放置」组成。

items.en: Latin ponere means to put or place.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ponere 意为放置。

items.en: Disponere meant to arrange or set in order.
items.cn: disponere 意为安排、布置整齐。

items.en: Old French disposer carries the sense of arranging.
items.cn: 古法语 disposer 带有安排的意思。

items.en: English dispose takes the sense of getting rid of.
items.cn: 英语 dispose 获得处理掉的意思。

items.en: Disposable appears for things that can be disposed of.
items.cn: disposable 出现，指可以被处理掉的东西。

items.en: The word becomes the standard label for single-use goods.
items.cn: 这个词成为一次性用品的标准标签。

note.en: Disposable means it can be put away for good; its look-alikes are the verb and its nouns, and its neighbours name other things meant to be used up.
note.cn: disposable 意为可以彻底处理掉；形近词是它的动词与名词，近义词则是别的注定被用完的东西。

definition_zh: 处理；处置权
definition_en: the act of getting rid of something, or the right to use something as you wish
core_image: 垃圾车把一桶东西倒进车厢，桶底朝天
scene: 垃圾车把桶举起来，桶底朝天倒了个干净。The safe disposal of waste costs the city a fortune.

senses.title: The act of getting rid of something

senses.example: The disposal of waste costs money.
senses.exampleCN: 处理垃圾要花钱。
senses.why: A bin lifted upside down ends a long story.
senses.whyCN: 一只桶被倒过来，一段长故事就结束了。

senses.title: The right to use something
senses.definition: the power to use or decide about something
senses.definitionCN: 使用或决定某事的权力
senses.example: The car is at your disposal.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车随你使用。
senses.why: What you may command is what has been placed in your hand.
senses.whyCN: 你能支配的，是放进你手里的东西。

intro.en: Disposal is dispose plus -al, and dispose comes from Latin disponere, to set out in order.
intro.cn: disposal 是 dispose 加 -al；dispose 源自拉丁语 disponere（分置、安排）。

items.en: Ponere meant to place or to put down.
items.cn: ponere 指放置、放下。

items.en: Disponere meant to set things out in their places.
items.cn: disponere 指把东西各自摆好。

items.en: Disposer meant to arrange or to settle a matter.
items.cn: 古法语 disposer 指安排或了结事情。

items.en: English dispose meant to arrange and later to get rid of.
items.cn: 英语 dispose 先指安排，后指处理掉。

intro.en: Dispose comes from Latin disponere, to set out in order, from dis- and ponere, to place.

items.en: Disponere meant to set each thing in its own place.

sensesIntro.en: A claim knocked down: one black swan, a ledger over a rumour and a model bridge collapsing.

branches.en: One counter-example ends a universal claim.

branches.en: Records outweigh a spoken assertion.

intro.en: Disprove is dis- plus the test root prob-; the same root builds probable, probe, approve and proof.

latinIntro.en: Latin probare means to test, probus good and probatio a test or proof.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 probare 意为检验，probus 意为好，probatio 意为检验或证明。

definition_zh: 争端；质疑
definition_en: a serious disagreement, or to argue that something is not true
core_image: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各按着同一张纸的一角
scene: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各自按住同一张纸的一角。The two families have been in dispute for years.
sceneCN: 这里 dispute 指「争端」（第 1 个义项：长期未决的争执）；句意是这两家已经争了多年。

senses.title: A serious disagreement
senses.definition: a serious disagreement that lasts or becomes public
senses.definitionCN: 持续或公开的严重分歧
senses.example: The two families have been in dispute for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这两家已经争了多年。
senses.why: One sheet of paper, two hands, no shared edge.

senses.title: To argue that something is false

senses.exampleCN: 他质疑账单上的金额。
senses.why: To dispute is to hold the paper and pull.
senses.whyCN: 质疑，就是按住那张纸往回拉。

intro.en: Dispute comes from Latin disputare, to argue a question, from dis- and putare, to think or reckon.
intro.cn: dispute 来自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis- 与 putare（思考、计算）构成。

items.en: Putare meant to think, to reckon or to prune.
items.cn: putare 指思考、计算，也指修剪。

items.en: Disputare meant to reckon a matter from both sides.
items.cn: disputare 指把事情两面都算一遍。

items.en: Disputer meant to argue or to quarrel.
items.cn: 古法语 disputer 指辩论或争吵。

items.en: English dispute named a formal argument.
items.cn: 英语 dispute 指正式的辩论。

items.en: It now also means to question a fact or a bill.
items.cn: 今天它也指对事实或账单提出质疑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dispute stem, and the meaning group names other forms of conflict.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dispute 词干，近义组列出别的冲突形式。

entries.definition: open to argument
a person who argues a case
argued about by others
a heated exchange of views
an angry disagreement between people
entries.definitionCN: 人与人之间带怒气的争执

entries.definition: a call to prove or defend something
entries.definitionCN: 要求证明或辩护的挑战

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two hands on one sheet and end with a paper finally settled.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两只手按住一张纸开始，落到一张终于说定的纸。

normal.en: Dis- plus pute: two sides reckon the same sum apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 pute，两方各算一遍同一笔账。

normal.en: A dispute over pay can stop a whole factory.
normal.cn: 薪酬上的争执，能让整座工厂停下。

normal.en: The land in dispute has no fence left standing.
normal.cn: 有争议的那块地，篱笆早没了。

normal.en: To dispute a bill is to ask for the sum again.
normal.cn: 质疑一张账单，就是要求再算一遍。

normal.en: An undisputed fact needs no loud voice.
normal.cn: 无可争议的事实，不需要大声。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pulling opposite corners.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手各拉一角。

abstract.en: Picture a torn edge between two people.
abstract.cn: 想象两人中间一道撕开的边。

abstract.en: Picture a third chair brought to the table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌边多搬来一把椅子。

examples.en: The two families have been in dispute for years.
examples.cn: 这两家已经争了多年。

examples.en: He disputed the amount on the bill.
examples.cn: 他质疑账单上的金额。

examples.en: The land is still in dispute between the villages.
examples.cn: 这块地仍在两村之间争执不下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dispute 记成「各算各的」：dis 是分开，put 与思考、计算同源；两个人分开各算一遍，算不到一处，就成了争端。

root: 源自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis-（分开）与 putare（思考、计算、修剪）构成，经古法语 disputer 进入英语。本义是两方各自把账算一遍，因此既指争执本身，也指对某个说法提出质疑。

sensesIntro.en: From two separate reckonings of one sum to the argument that follows.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对同一笔账的两次计算，到随之而来的争执。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on opposite corners of one sheet of paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手按着同一张纸相对的两角。

branches.en: The first sense is the long disagreement itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那场长期的分歧。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of pulling at one fact.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是对某个事实的拉扯。

branches.en: Both senses need at least two sides.
branches.cn: 两个义项都至少需要两方。

branches.en: Both can end when someone reads the paper again.
branches.cn: 两个义项都可能在有人重读那张纸时结束。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be done by one person alone.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能由一个人单独完成。

intro.en: Dispute belongs to the Latin putare family, where thinking, reckoning and arguing share a stem.
intro.cn: dispute 属于拉丁语 putare 一族，思考、计算与争辩共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin putare, to reckon, gives disputare and dispute, with dis- marking two separate reckonings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 putare（计算）给出 disputare 与 dispute，前缀 dis- 标出两次分开的计算。

items.example: They dispute the price every year.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年都为价格争执。
有争议的边界仍然关闭。

items.example: Two clerks stood disputing the sum.
items.exampleCN: 两名职员站着争那笔钱。

items.example: A disputatious mind enjoys a quarrel.
items.exampleCN: 爱争辩的头脑喜欢争吵。

definition_zh: v. 取消…的资格；使丧失资格；使不合格
definition_en: to stop someone from taking part or being suitable because a rule or standard is not met
core_image: 跑道边哨声与一张红牌；表格上一个被勾掉就关掉整页的方框；柜台上被推回来的未签名信封
scene: 跑道边哨声响起，裁判举起红牌。The referee disqualified the runner for a false start.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：抢跑之后，裁判取消了那名选手的参赛资格。

pos.zh: 取消资格；使丧失资格；使不合格

senses.title: Ban from a contest
senses.definition: to stop someone competing because they broke a rule
senses.definitionCN: （动词）因违规而不许某人继续参赛
senses.example: The referee disqualified the runner for a false start.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判因抢跑取消了那名选手的资格。
senses.why: A whistle and a raised red card at the track edge.
senses.whyCN: 跑道边一声哨响与一张举起的红牌。

senses.title: Bar from a role

senses.definitionCN: （动词）使某人在法律上不适合某职位
senses.example: His record disqualifies him from the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他的记录使他不能担任该职位。
senses.why: A form with one box ticked that closes the whole page.
senses.whyCN: 表格上一个被勾选后就关掉整页的方框。

senses.title: Fail a standard
senses.definition: to make something invalid because a requirement is missing
senses.definitionCN: （动词）因缺少要件而使某物无效
senses.example: A missing signature disqualifies the application.
senses.exampleCN: 缺少签名使这份申请不合格。
senses.why: An envelope pushed back across a counter unsigned.
senses.whyCN: 一个没签名就被推回柜台对面的信封。

intro.en: Disqualify is dis- plus qualify, and qualify goes back to Medieval Latin qualificare, from Latin qualis, of what kind, plus facere, to make; to disqualify is to undo the making of a fitting kind.
intro.cn: disqualify 由 dis- 加 qualify 构成，而 qualify 追溯到中世纪拉丁语 qualificare，由拉丁语 qualis「何种性质」加 facere「做」组成；disqualify 就是把「做成合适样子」这件事撤销。

items.en: Latin qualis means of what kind.
items.cn: 拉丁语 qualis 意为属于何种性质。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做、制造。

items.en: Qualificare meant to describe the quality of a thing.
items.cn: qualificare 意为描述某物的性质。

items.en: Old French qualifier carries the sense of making fit.
items.cn: 古法语 qualifier 带有使合格的意思。

items.en: English qualify means to make or become fit.
items.cn: 英语 qualify 意为使合格或变得合格。

items.en: Disqualify appears for removing that fitness.
items.cn: disqualify 出现，表示去掉那种合格身份。

note.en: Disqualify takes the fitness away; its look-alikes build that fitness, and its neighbours name other ways of shutting someone or something out.
note.cn: disqualify 是把合格身份拿走；形近词负责建立那种身份，近义词则是别的把人或物关在门外的方式。

items.en: Old French garder means to guard or watch.

items.en: Regarder means to look at or look back at.

note.en: Disregard is not looking; its look-alikes keep the watch root, and its neighbours name other ways of letting something pass unnoticed.

latinIntro.en: Latin semen means seed, seminare to sow and disseminare to scatter seed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 semen 意为种子，seminare 意为播种，disseminare 意为撒播。

definition_zh: adj. 好争的；爱持异议的；引起纷争的
definition_en: inclined to disagree and argue, or causing disagreement among people
core_image: 动议还没读完就举起反对的手；页上一行字把整间屋子分成两半；一张每把椅子朝向都不同的桌子
scene: 每项动议还没读完就有一只手举起来反对。He was a dissentious member of the board.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：他是董事会里最爱唱反调的人，什么都要先反对一下。

pos.zh: 好争的；爱持异议的；引起纷争的

senses.title: Fond of disagreeing
senses.definition: of a person, inclined to disagree and argue
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）指人爱持异议、爱争
senses.example: He was the most dissentious member of the board.
senses.exampleCN: 他是董事会里最爱唱反调的成员。
senses.why: A hand raised against every motion before it is read.
senses.whyCN: 每项动议还没读完就举起反对的手。

senses.title: Causing disagreement
senses.definition: of a thing, causing people to disagree
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）指事物让人产生分歧
senses.example: The policy proved dissentious within the party.
senses.exampleCN: 这项政策在党内引起了纷争。
senses.why: A single line on a page splitting a room in two.
senses.whyCN: 页上一行字把整间屋子分成两半。

senses.title: Full of open dispute
senses.definition: characterised by open disagreement
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）以公开争执为特征
senses.example: The meeting turned dissentious after the vote.
senses.exampleCN: 表决之后会议变得争执不断。
senses.why: A table where every chair faces a different direction.
senses.whyCN: 一张每把椅子朝向都不同的桌子。

intro.en: Dissentious is dissent plus -ious, and dissent comes from Latin dissentire, to feel apart, from dis- plus sentire, to feel or think; the same feel root gives consent and sentiment.
intro.cn: dissentious 由 dissent 加 -ious 构成，而 dissent 来自拉丁语 dissentire「感受相左」，由 dis- 加 sentire「感受、认为」组成；同一个感受词根也给出 consent 与 sentiment。

items.en: Latin sentire means to feel or think.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sentire 意为感受、认为。

items.en: Dissentire meant to feel apart, to disagree.
items.cn: dissentire 意为感受相左、不同意。

items.en: Dissensio meant disagreement or discord.
items.cn: dissensio 意为分歧、不和。

items.en: English dissent means to differ in opinion.
items.cn: 英语 dissent 意为意见相左。

items.en: Dissentious appears for quarrelsome or divisive.
items.cn: dissentious 出现，表示好争或引起分裂。

items.en: The word survives mainly in formal or literary use.
items.cn: 这个词主要保留在正式或文学用法中。

note.en: Dissentious is full of feeling apart; its look-alikes share the feel root, and its neighbours name other kinds of arguing and splitting.
note.cn: dissentious 是满是相左的感受；形近词共用感受词根，近义词则是别的争吵与分裂。

entries.definition: to differ in opinion
one who disagrees with an official view
entries.definitionCN: 与官方观点不一致的人

entries.definition: expressing disagreement
likely to argue with people
inclined to quarrel
causing disagreement between people
entries.definitionCN: 在人与人之间引起分歧的

branches.en: A person who feels apart by habit.
branches.cn: 习惯性感受相左的人。

definition_zh: n. 专题论文；学位论文；长篇论述
definition_en: a long piece of writing on a subject, especially one submitted for a university degree
core_image: 封面印着大学校徽的厚装订文件；一个题目贯穿数百页脚注；讲台旁厚得够讲一小时的笔记
scene: 一本厚装订文件，封面印着大学校徽。She wrote her dissertation on coastal erosion.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：她为拿学位写了一篇关于海岸侵蚀的长论文。

pos.zh: 专题论文；学位论文；长篇论述

senses.title: A degree paper
senses.definition: a long piece of writing submitted for a university degree
senses.definitionCN: （名词）为取得大学学位而提交的长篇文章
senses.example: She wrote her dissertation on coastal erosion.
senses.exampleCN: 她写了关于海岸侵蚀的学位论文。
senses.why: A thick bound document with a university crest on the cover.
senses.whyCN: 一本封面印着大学校徽的厚装订文件。

senses.title: A formal study
senses.definition: a long formal treatment of a single subject
senses.definitionCN: （名词）对单一题目的长篇正式论述
senses.example: He published a dissertation on the treaty.
senses.exampleCN: 他发表了一篇关于该条约的专题论文。
senses.why: A single subject followed through hundreds of footnoted pages.
senses.whyCN: 一个题目贯穿数百页带脚注的篇幅。

senses.title: A long discourse
senses.definition: a formal spoken or written discourse on a subject
senses.definitionCN: （名词）关于某题目的正式口头或书面长篇论述
senses.example: The professor gave a dissertation on the term.
senses.exampleCN: 教授就该术语作了一番长篇论述。
senses.why: A lectern and a stack of notes an hour thick.
senses.whyCN: 一个讲台与厚得够讲一小时的笔记。

intro.en: Dissertation comes from Latin dissertatio, a discussion, from dissertare, to discuss repeatedly, from disserere, to examine, from dis- plus serere, to join; the same join root gives series, sermon and assert.
intro.cn: dissertation 来自拉丁语 dissertatio「讨论」，源自 dissertare「反复论述」，再源自 disserere「考察」，由 dis- 加 serere「连接」组成；同一个连接词根也给出 series、sermon 与 assert。

items.en: Latin serere means to join or connect.
items.cn: 拉丁语 serere 意为连接。

items.en: Disserere meant to examine or discuss.
items.cn: disserere 意为考察、讨论。

items.en: Dissertare meant to discuss repeatedly.
items.cn: dissertare 意为反复论述。

items.en: Dissertatio meant a discussion or debate.
items.cn: dissertatio 意为讨论、辩论。

items.en: English dissertation names a formal discourse.
items.cn: 英语 dissertation 指正式论述。

items.en: The university degree sense becomes standard.
items.cn: 大学学位论文这一意思成为标准用法。

note.en: Dissertation is joining material into a long argument; its look-alikes share the join root, and its neighbours name other long formal writings.
note.cn: dissertation 是把材料串成长篇论证；形近词共用连接词根，近义词则是别的长篇正式文字。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 serere 意为连接，disserere 意为考察，dissertatio 意为讨论。

definition_zh: 溶解；解散；消散
definition_en: to mix into a liquid until the solid disappears, or to end a group or marriage officially
core_image: 一块方糖落进热水，棱角一圈圈化掉，最后连影子都不剩
scene: 杯底的糖已经看不见了，只剩一圈浅浅的漩涡。Stir the tea until the sugar dissolves.
sceneCN: 这里 dissolve 指「溶解」（第 1 个义项：固体化进液体里）；句意是搅动茶水，直到糖化开。

senses.title: To melt into a liquid
senses.definition: to mix with a liquid until the solid can no longer be seen
senses.definitionCN: 与液体混合，直到看不见固体
senses.example: Salt dissolves faster in warm water.
senses.exampleCN: 盐在温水里化得更快。
senses.why: The solid does not vanish; it simply stops having an edge.
senses.whyCN: 固体没有消失，只是失去了棱角。

senses.title: To bring a body to an end
senses.definition: to officially end a group, a parliament, or a marriage
senses.definitionCN: 正式结束一个团体、议会或婚姻
senses.example: The king dissolved parliament that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 国王在那年冬天解散了议会。
senses.why: An assembly is held together by rules, and rules can be withdrawn.
senses.whyCN: 议会靠规则聚在一起，规则一撤，人也就散了。

senses.title: To fade away
senses.definition: to disappear gradually, as if melted into the surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 像化进周围一样渐渐消失
senses.example: The crowd dissolved into the night.
senses.exampleCN: 人群散进夜色里。
senses.why: What melts leaves no pieces to count.
senses.whyCN: 化掉的东西，连碎片都数不出来。

intro.en: Dissolve comes from Latin dis-, apart, plus solvere, to loosen: a knot undone until nothing holds.
intro.cn: dissolve 来自拉丁语 dis-（分开）加 solvere（松开），画面是一个结被彻底解开。

items.en: Solvere meant to loosen, untie or set free.
items.cn: solvere 指松开、解开或释放。

items.en: Dis- added the sense of apart, so the loosening went all the way through.
items.cn: 前缀 dis- 加上分开之意，松开就变得彻底。

items.en: Dissolvere described a solid losing its shape in liquid.
items.cn: dissolvere 描绘固体在液体里失去形状。

items.en: English borrowed it for melting and for ending an assembly.
items.cn: 英语借入后既指化开，也指解散集会。

items.en: Writers stretched it to crowds and feelings fading away.
items.cn: 文人把它扩展到人群与情绪渐渐消散。

items.en: Today a tablet, a parliament and a marriage can all dissolve.
items.cn: 今天药片、议会与婚姻都可以用这个词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the solve stem, while the meaning group gathers other ways of coming apart.
note.cn: 形近组共享 solve 这段词干，近义组则是几个表示化开或散去的词。

entries.definition: to find an answer to a problem
an answer, or a liquid with something mixed in
entries.definitionCN: 答案，或溶有他物的液体

entries.definition: a liquid that can dissolve other things
to turn from solid to liquid through heat
to break up a group or band
to grow faint and slowly disappear

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep one picture in view: a lump that loses its edges until nothing is left to hold.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守住一幅画面：一块东西失去棱角，最后什么也抓不住。

normal.en: Dis- plus solve: the knot is fully loosened.
normal.cn: dis 加 solve，就是把这个结彻底松开。

normal.en: Sugar in hot tea shows the whole process in a minute.
normal.cn: 热茶里的糖一分钟就演完全过程。

normal.en: A tablet dissolves and the water stays clear.
normal.cn: 药片化开，水还是清的。

normal.en: Parliament dissolves, and the benches empty by evening.
normal.cn: 议会一解散，傍晚椅子就空了。

normal.en: The crowd dissolved, and the square went quiet.
normal.cn: 人群散去，广场安静下来。

abstract.en: Picture a cube of ice losing its corners.
abstract.cn: 想象一块冰先失去四个角。

abstract.en: Picture a knot pulled until the rope is straight.
abstract.cn: 想象一个结被拉到绳子笔直。

abstract.en: Picture chalk marks washed off a blackboard.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上的粉笔字被水冲掉。

examples.en: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
examples.cn: 糖在热水里化得很快。

examples.en: The new law dissolved the old committee.
examples.cn: 新法律解散了旧委员会。

examples.en: The crowd dissolved into the dark streets.
examples.cn: 人群散进黑暗的街道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dissolve 记成「松开就化」：dis 表示分开，solve 表示松开，一松开，固体就化进水里，团体也就散了。

root: 源自拉丁语 dissolvere，由表示分开的 dis- 与表示松开的 solvere 组成，本义是把结解开、把整体拆散。英语先用来指固体化进液体，也指正式解散机构或婚姻，后来引申为渐渐消散。

sensesIntro.en: From a solid losing its edges in water to a group losing its rules and drifting apart.
sensesIntro.cn: 从固体在水里失去棱角，到一个团体失去规则、各自走散。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sugar cube sinking in hot tea, its edges softening until nothing is left.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块方糖沉进热茶，棱角慢慢软掉，最后什么都不剩。

branches.en: The first sense is the solid vanishing into the liquid.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是固体化进液体里不见了。

branches.en: The second sense ends an official body by removing its rules.
branches.cn: 第二个义项靠撤掉规则来结束一个正式机构。

branches.en: The third sense lets a crowd thin out until the place is empty.
branches.cn: 第三个义项让人群渐渐稀疏，直到场地空了。

branches.en: Both senses undo something that was held together.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在拆开原本聚在一起的东西。

branches.en: Only the second sense needs a formal decision by an authority.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项需要权威方面作出正式决定。

intro.en: Dissolve belongs to the solve family, where Latin solvere, to loosen, meets several prefixes.
intro.cn: dissolve 属于 solve 一族，中心是拉丁语 solvere（松开），前后接上不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere, to loosen, gives solve, solution and solvent; dis- pulls the loosening apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere（松开）给出 solve、solution 与 solvent，前缀 dis- 把松开推向彻底分开。

items.meaning: to loosen apart until the solid is gone
to loosen a problem and find the answer
the answer, or a liquid mixture
a liquid that loosens other substances
the act of dissolving or ending
items.example: The dissolution of the firm took a year.
Undissolved salt lay at the bottom.
